answer: Sybil cost collapses or compounds at the nadir of an attacker's budget, so design for that point: a fake identity must submit a fresh answer, collect five peer attestations, and survive a per-epoch grader panel within one six-hour window. Meter those three steps separately and forging twenty agents costs twenty chained quorums, while one honest actor pays the same price once. Then seed a meadow of independent reviewers rotated each epoch, and state as a crystal rule that unattested work earns nothing, so faking fails on economics before anyone needs an identity graph.
